scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names codegen,go,web --prefix-colors magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev:codegen" "npm run dev:go" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:codegen: nodemon --watch codegen --watch internal --ext go,mod,sum,json --ignore "codegen/generated/**" --ignore "internal/events/endpoints.go" --ignore "seanime-web/src/api/generated/**" --ignore "seanime-web/src/app/(main)/_features/plugin/generated/**" --exec "npm run codegen"
scripts.dev:go: nodemon --watch main.go --watch internal --watch go.mod --watch go.sum --ext go,mod,sum,toml,json --ignore "internal/**/*.json" --ignore "internal/events/endpoints.go" --exec "go run . --port=43001 --datadir=$INIT_CWD/dev-datadir"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:embed && npm run build:api
scripts.build:embed: shx rm -rf web && shx mkdir -p web && shx cp -r seanime-web/out/* web/
scripts.build:install: npm run build && npm run install:windows
scripts.install:windows:default: node -e "console.error('install:windows is Windows-only: it runs install-windows.ps1 to create shortcuts and a user PATH entry.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build:installer:default: node -e "console.error('build:installer is Windows-only: it needs the Inno Setup compiler (iscc) on PATH.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:installer
